frozen.disclosure: VisionJEV 1.0.0 is a 27B model built on Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, with a decision readout over the last-token hidden state. The repository NOTICE attributes the prompt, answer conversion and noncausal attention hook to autojev/pplx-decider. TEXT ONLY: the vision-capable model was measured without images. SERVING: the author's own shipped model and documented HTTP server, unmodified, BF16, SDPA, noncausal full attention, last-token pooling, temperature 0.986316004609301, batch size 1, no thinking, one forward pass, no truncation, quantisation, rereading or retries. Contributor code ran only on a disposable rented pod with network cut. ITEMS: all 1,500 items were sent; 5 exceeded the native 8,192-token input limit and were refused with HTTP 422, scored as misses and kept in the denominator; these carry no usage and are unbilled. 1,495 items were answered. TOKENS: output tokens reported as 0; native input usage is the observed length of input ids at the native prepare call, 562,151 input tokens on answered requests. TRAINING: training data were not inspected; overlap with public or sealed JevBench items is unchecked. DETERMINISM: 49 of 50 replayed requests were bit-identical, with 0 argmax flips (recorded maximum probability difference 0.0). WARM-UP: a public synthetic warm-up preceded the timed measurements; the first cold smoke request took about 42 seconds. LATENCY: measured loopback p50 0.152 s, p95 0.290 s, maximum 9.297 s; the self-hosted share estimate is twice measured p50 plus 0.15 seconds, an assumption rather than a hosted endpoint measurement. HARDWARE: one A100 80 GB GPU; weights alone occupy 48.6 GiB and smoke peak allocated memory was 50.2 GiB. LICENCE: Apache-2.0 with NOTICE preserved. The 27 Oct 2026 draw is not yet equated to the reference scale (offset 0). This draw has no subject-topic labels yet, so the row has no topic cells; use-case and language cells are measured on its own draw.
frozen.endpoint_condition: Self-hosted on one evaluator-rented Verda NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB in Finland (EU), using the author's own documented HTTP server on loopback; BF16 and SDPA. Measured 29 Oct 2026. Public warm-up preceded timed measurements. The model, source and input were read-only, network cut before scored input. GPU rental is separate from the estimated model tariff.
